title: Dance-Pop
style: A groove-driven 124bpm pop, synth-pop, and funk fusion: pulsating synths and syncopated funk guitar ride over tight handclaps and a punchy, rhythmic bass. Fast, bright mid-low vocals lead, with sharp drums and synth stabs fueling the choruses. The bridge blends upbeat pop rock and soft rock elements, adding lush harmonies and airy synth layers, then surges back to an energetic, infectious finish.
